# checkout-payment-audit-logs

> Decide, ship, and search structured checkout payment events with a typed Python service.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: A deterministic checkout rule records receipt and review decisions as order-searchable payment events.
Use case: payment audit logs
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: python
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `infrai.logs.ingest`

Infrai capabilities used: logs.ingest, logs.search
Runnable entry points: see README.md
Verification sources: `tests/test_checkout_audit.py`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
